His wife's been at this gate since dawn.
Found me? The lad saved my hide.
Slimes, hornets, and a wolf that... *melted*.
It's a long story. I'll put it in my report.
Then go and report. I'll walk Tobin to the healer.
Thank you, Kael. The next round at
the Lion's Rest is on me.
Bandits. We caught them in Briarwood.

I carried their cargo. And when I lost it,

I'll speak to Sera too. She'll hear the whole story.
